## Statement

Give the statement and its relation to a question in the repository.

## Hypotheses and scope

Specify the field, group, residue characteristic, coefficient field, and any further assumptions.
Does this concern construction, exhaustion, or another question?

## Argument

Outline the steps and identify the supporting results, with precise references and hypotheses.
Mark conditional or unproved steps explicitly. A full proof can be submitted in a pull request.

## Checks and related work

Give examples or calculations that test the statement and cite relevant prior work. Describe any
AI assistance used; neither AI review nor automated checks establish mathematical correctness.
